يلتزمون (form VIII)
# يَلْتَزِمُونَ (yaltazimūna) /jal.ta.zi.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# يُلْتَزَمُونَ (yultazamūna) /jul.ta.za.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
